title: A strange hiccup virus suddenly broke out in Bikini Bottom.#anime #usa #foryou #spongebob
description: Two kids ate extremely spicy chips, and the spiciness reacted with strange chemicals around them to create contagious hiccup gas. The virus bubbles they released were inhaled by SpongeBob, making him the first infected person.
